case: invalidate — an archive the real matrix cannot check
why: Against the REAL published matrix: Godot declares no expected C ABI anywhere in the repo (only Unity does), so the matrix publishes null and there is nothing to compare the archive's stamp against. Uncheckable is not matching.

archive.note: A Go-Explore archive entry. TBP's save_checkpoint response carries {id, tier, frame, latency_ms, bytes, level} and no version field, so these axes are stamped by the adapter alongside the id.
